revision_note: v2 (owner-directed): tiers re-adjudicated PURELY against external literature; internal diagnostic-only gates no longer drive the tier. K entries carry a citation or an explicit textbook-level note; C entries name the exact external study and quantity cross-checked; P/S entries state the delta over existing research. Scope/conditionality of each result remains in its section's claim boundary, separate from the novelty tier.

rubric.C: cross-check: our number/result checks against a NAMED external study's quantity (agreement or registered disagreement)
rubric.K: known: published result or textbook-level mathematics; the cited source (or a textbook-level note) is given; our contribution is re-derivation or implementation verification
rubric.P: potential advance: a stated delta over the named closest literature, at method or partial-result level
rubric.S: significant: a completed, externally-novel result whose delta over the named closest literature is itself a claimable scientific contribution (theory results complete as mathematics; data results complete as test-plus-measurement)
